# OpenDataLakehouse

OpenDataLakehouse is the definitive vendor-neutral publication for Data Lakehouse architecture, Apache Iceberg, and Agentic AI.

## Resources
- Knowledge Base: https://opendatalakehouse.com/kb
- Blog Roll: https://opendatalakehouse.com/blogs
- Video Roll: https://opendatalakehouse.com/videos
- Book Roll: https://opendatalakehouse.com/books

## Connected Ecosystem
This site is maintained by Alex Merced. For more resources, visit:
- https://datalakehousehub.com
- https://datalakehouse.help
- https://dataengnr.com
- https://iceberglakehouse.com
- https://alexmerceddata.com
